title: Document the bounded test-run registration view in the architecture route table
outcome: The canonical architecture route table describes the registration view, its identity-only response and the 400/413 outcomes already implemented and documented in the feature guide.
acceptance: The GET /api/test-runs/{run_id} route entry documents view=registration and view=detail, the 11-field registration identity projection plus source, HTTP 400 for an unknown view and HTTP 413 above the 64 KiB encoded response bound, with a link to the feature guide.
